meta.title: Nixus Cloud account
meta.description: Sign in to view and edit your Nixus Cloud profile.
profile.heading: Profile
profile.noSubdivisions: This country has no regions to choose from.
profile.conflict: Your profile was reloaded because the saved version was newer than the one on this page. Check the values and save again.
profile.indeterminate: Nixus could not confirm whether the save went through. Reload the page before trying again.
profile.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to save.
profile.avatar.heading: Picture
profile.avatar.unreadable: That file could not be read as an image.
profile.avatar.tooLarge: That picture could not be shrunk small enough. Try a simpler image.
error.validation: Check the highlighted field and try again.
error.version_conflict: This profile changed since the page loaded.
error.payload_too_large: That was too large to send.
error.unsupported_media: That file type is not supported.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.
error.unavailable: Nixus could not reach the profile service. Try again shortly.
error.premium_required: Your plan does not include this feature yet.
error.promotion_invalid: That code could not be applied.
error.checkout_in_progress: A checkout is already open for your account.
error.client_too_old: This page is out of date. Reload it and try again.
billing.heading: Plan and billing
billing.includedNone: Your plan includes no paid features yet.
billing.requestLimitUnlimited: Hosted AI requests each month: no set limit
billing.plansUnavailable: Nixus could not load the plan list. Reload the page shortly.
billing.switchHint: You have an active subscription. Choosing a plan opens Stripe's secure portal, where you can see exactly what changes — including any credit or charge — before you confirm.
billing.taxIncluded: Prices are listed in Canadian dollars and charged in your own currency at checkout, with tax included.
billing.hostedNotice: Payment and plan changes happen on Stripe's own secure pages. Nixus never asks for a card number.
billing.manageHint: Opens the secure portal where you can change your payment method, switch plan or cancel.
billing.checkoutInProgress: A checkout is already open for your account. Finish it in the other tab, or try again in a few minutes.
billing.promotionInvalid: That code could not be applied. You can continue without it.
billing.indeterminate: Nixus could not confirm whether that went through. Wait a moment and reload the page before trying again.
billing.error.unavailable: Nixus could not reach the billing service. Your plan is unchanged. Try again shortly.
billing.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
checkout.heading: Thank you
checkout.updating: Your payment went through. Your plan is updating.
checkout.pending: Your payment went through. Your plan is still updating — this page does not need to stay open, and your plan will be ready shortly.
checkout.unavailable: Your payment went through. Nixus could not read your plan just now; reload this page in a moment.
reason.invalid_type: This value is not in the expected format.
reason.invalid_format: This value is not in the expected format.
reason.not_allowed: This value is not one of the accepted options.
reason.in_future: A date of birth cannot be in the future.
reason.too_young: Nixus Cloud accounts are for people aged 18 and over.
reason.no_subdivisions: This country has no regions to choose from.
reason.dimensions_exceeded: The picture is larger than 256 pixels.
reason.unknown_field: This form sent something the service does not accept.
reason.too_long: This value is longer than permitted.
reason.out_of_range: This value is outside the permitted range.
